hero.title: The Comfort of Home,
hero.description: Good food brings comfort, happiness and people together. At Aapla Dabba, we bring you fresh, homestyle meals prepared with care to make your everyday meals more enjoyable.

story.label: OUR STORY
story.title: Every Dabba Has a Little Taste of Home.
story.paragraph1: Aapla Dabba is built around a simple thought: everyone deserves a comforting and satisfying meal, even on the busiest days.
story.paragraph2: Whether you are working, studying or managing a busy routine, we want to make everyday meals easier with food that feels familiar, filling and comforting.
story.paragraph3: For us, a good meal is more than just food. It is the warmth, care and comfort that make you feel at home.

beginning.label: HOW IT BEGAN
beginning.title: A Simple Idea,
beginning.paragraph1: Aapla Dabba is built around the idea that everyday food should be fresh, satisfying and comforting. We want to make it easier for people to enjoy homemade-style meals even when their busy schedules keep them away from home.
beginning.paragraph2: From the familiar taste of everyday meals to the comfort of a well-prepared tiffin, our goal is to bring warmth and convenience to your dining experience.

plans.question: Are weekly and monthly plans available?

areas.question: Which areas do you serve?

preferences.question: Can I request special meal preferences?
preferences.answer: Yes. Mention your food preferences, meal quantity and timings in the additional requirements field.

pricing.question: How can I enquire about pricing?
pricing.answer: Submit the enquiry form with your preferred plan to discuss pricing and availability.
